project_type: Java library - Apache Lucene search engine
build_system: Gradle 9.2.1 via gradlew wrapper. Requires JDK 25 (set via mise). Use JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH before gradlew commands.
test_framework: JUnit via randomizedtesting framework. Tests extend LuceneTestCase. Uses MockAnalyzer for test analyzers.
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:compileJava :lucene:queryparser:compileTestJava --no-daemon -q
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:test --no-daemon -q
verification_instructions: 1. Build: run build_command. 2. Run tests: run test_command. 3. Run tidy: ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:tidy --no-daemon. 4. Check specific test: ./gradlew -p lucene/queryparser test --tests TestBM25FQueryParser
setup_instructions: JDK 25 is already available via mise. Gradle wrapper handles gradle download. Run: cd /projects/sandbox/lucene && JAVA_HOME=$(mise where java@25) PATH=$(mise where java@25)/bin:$PATH ./gradlew :lucene:queryparser:compileJava --no-daemon -q
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external package installation. JDK 25 already available. Gradle already cached after initial build. Cannot run docker. Must use pre-existing tools only.
contribution_requirements: Run ./gradlew tidy for code formatting. Add Apache license headers. Follow existing Lucene coding patterns. Tests must extend LuceneTestCase.
key_patterns: Query parsers live in lucene/queryparser/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/<name>/. Tests live in lucene/queryparser/src/test/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/<name>/. SimpleQueryParser extends QueryBuilder and overrides newDefaultQuery/newPhraseQuery/newPrefixQuery/newFuzzyQuery to iterate over field weights. CombinedFieldQuery (core) is per-term BM25F: CombinedFieldQuery.Builder(termString).addField(field, weight).build(). Module exports must be added to module-info.java. The queryparser module depends on lucene:core (which has CombinedFieldQuery).
directory_structure: lucene/ is the root module. lucene/core/ has CombinedFieldQuery and QueryBuilder. lucene/queryparser/ has all query parsers. lucene/queryparser/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/{classic,simple,flexible,...}/ are the parser packages. lucene/queryparser/src/test/org/apache/lucene/queryparser/{classic,simple,...}/ are the test packages.
